description:
The reader's brief compiled from the record you wrote: who they are, their morning, and lanes, each
standing on a target (world, country:XX, medtop:N, wd:Qn), an all_of or any_of of them, or what a piece says;
a lane may follow a story (storyline:N or thread:N, or its name), with `{up_to: N, when: sizeable}` for only a
morning it moved; a plain name in place of an id is resolved (one match taken; several: the first taken and one `question`).
Answers the record, `resolved`, `read_back` (a plain-language summary), `confirm` for save_brief; or `problem` with a
pointer and a fix per error. Nothing is saved.

brief.description: The brief: the record in YAML or JSON (the schema at /start/brief.schema.json, the example at /start/brief.example.yaml); a plain name where no id is known is resolved.

name: set_brief
title: Set the brief
